home.description: Manage your personal library, enable notifications, and never miss a new release again.
home.features_heading: Everything you need to track your media
home.features_desc: A complete tool to centralize, organize, and never miss anything from your favorite series.
home.advanced_search_text: Find any title among thousands of manga, manhwa, anime and series with precise filters: genre, status, reading platform and more.
home.personalized_tracking_text: Mark titles as Reading, Completed, Planned or On Hold. Rate them, add tags and find them instantly in your library.
home.notification_text: Get alerted as soon as a new chapter or episode drops, so you never miss an update from the series you follow.
home.multi_source_text: OharaTracker aggregates data from multiple platforms (MangaDex, AniList, Asura Scans…) to give you a unified view of all your content.
home.statistics_text: Track your activity: chapters read, estimated reading time, genre breakdown and your library's growth over time.
home.community_text: Share your profile, compare libraries with friends and see what the community is following right now.
home.screenshots_desc: A clean interface built for media enthusiasts — manga, anime, series.
home.screenshot_library_desc: List or cover view, filters, tags, notes and statuses: your collection organized the way you want.
home.screenshot_tracking_desc: Compare features across tiers and upgrade in one click when you're ready.
home.screenshot_profile_desc: Your reading history, statistics and recent activity — visible to friends if you choose.
home.quickstart_heading: Up and running in under a minute
home.steps1_desc: Free sign-up in seconds. No credit card required.
home.steps2_desc: Search for your favorite manga, manhwa, anime or series and add them to your library in one click.
home.steps3_title: Track and never miss a release
home.steps3_desc: Enable notifications, update your progress, and let OharaTracker alert you whenever something new drops.
home.cta_desc: Join thousands of users already tracking their manga, anime and series on OharaTracker.
home.footer: Free sign-up · No commitment · No ads
